_comment: pm-assistant: writes ONLY to personal/pm-assistant/ (private, gitignored). Calendar is read-only enrichment — the whole server is allowed because MCP permission rules do not support glob wildcards, so the write tools are denied individually. products/** writes are denied here (root allows working/ writes for the pipelines) because this agent's own subagents must never touch product artifacts — delegated pipelines run in the ROOT session under root settings, so delegation is unaffected.
